text: On 30 April 1999, the Adıyaman Governor authorised the holding of May Day celebrations in the Adıyaman Amphitheatre, located in the Hasancık District.
section_path: THE FACTS
I. THE CIRCUMSTANCES OF THE CASE

text: On 1 May 1999, a group of people, including the applicants, gathered in the building of the Health Workers' Trade Union.
section_path: THE FACTS
I. THE CIRCUMSTANCES OF THE CASE

text: On 1 May 1999, the group that had gathered in the building of the Health Workers' Trade Union started to walk towards the Adıyaman Amphitheatre for the May Day celebrations.
section_path: THE FACTS
I. THE CIRCUMSTANCES OF THE CASE

text: The group walking towards the Adıyaman Amphitheatre was stopped by police officers.
section_path: THE FACTS
I. THE CIRCUMSTANCES OF THE CASE

text: The group stated that they had obtained prior authorisation from the Adıyaman Governor and attempted to continue their march towards the Adıyaman Amphitheatre.
section_path: THE FACTS
I. THE CIRCUMSTANCES OF THE CASE

text: The police intervened to disperse the group that was attempting to continue its march towards the Adıyaman Amphitheatre.
section_path: THE FACTS
I. THE CIRCUMSTANCES OF THE CASE

text: The applicants were allegedly injured during the police intervention to disperse the group as a result of the force used by the police.
section_path: THE FACTS
I. THE CIRCUMSTANCES OF THE CASE

text: According to the incident report, thirty-eight people, including the applicants, were arrested during the incident on 1 May 1999.
section_path: THE FACTS
I. THE CIRCUMSTANCES OF THE CASE

text: Following their arrest, the applicants were taken to the Adıyaman State Hospital, where they were examined by a doctor.
section_path: THE FACTS

text: On different dates in May 1999, the applicants filed criminal complaints with the Adıyaman Public Prosecutor against those police officers who had allegedly used excessive force during the applicants' arrest on 1 May 1999.
section_path: THE FACTS
I. THE CIRCUMSTANCES OF THE CASE

text: On 17 June 1999, the Adıyaman Public Prosecutor transferred the case file to the Adıyaman Provincial Administrative Council.
section_path: THE FACTS
I. THE CIRCUMSTANCES OF THE CASE

text: The Adıyaman Public Prosecutor sought authorisation from the Adıyaman Provincial Administrative Council to bring criminal proceedings against the accused police officers, pursuant to the provisions of the Law on the Prosecution of Civil Servants.
section_path: THE FACTS
I. THE CIRCUMSTANCES OF THE CASE

text: On 16 February 2000, the Adıyaman Provincial Administrative Council found that there was not enough evidence to initiate criminal proceedings against the accused police officers.
section_path: THE FACTS
I. THE CIRCUMSTANCES OF THE CASE

text: On 16 February 2000, the Adıyaman Provincial Administrative Council refused to initiate criminal proceedings against the accused police officers.
section_path: THE FACTS
I. THE CIRCUMSTANCES OF THE CASE

text: On 1 September 2000, the applicants appealed against the decision of the Adıyaman Provincial Administrative Council of 16 February 2000.
section_path: THE FACTS
I. THE CIRCUMSTANCES OF THE CASE

text: In their appeal petition, the applicants invoked a breach of Article 11 of the Convention, arguing that the police interference had breached their freedom of assembly.
section_path: THE FACTS
I. THE CIRCUMSTANCES OF THE CASE

text: On 14 June 2001, the Supreme Administrative Council upheld the decision of the Adıyaman Provincial Administrative Council of 16 February 2000 refusing to initiate criminal proceedings against the accused police officers.

text: On 1 June 1999, the Adıyaman Public Prosecutor examined a video recording of the incident of 1 May 1999.
section_path: THE FACTS
I. THE CIRCUMSTANCES OF THE CASE

text: On 1 June 1999, the Adıyaman Public Prosecutor delivered a decision not to prosecute with regard to seventy demonstrators, including the applicants, who had been involved in the incident on 1 May 1999.
section_path: THE FACTS
I. THE CIRCUMSTANCES OF THE CASE

text: In his decision of 1 June 1999, the Adıyaman Public Prosecutor stated that the demonstrators had been stopped by the police, although they had been walking silently along the pavement, without presenting a danger to the public or engaging in any violent activities.
section_path: THE FACTS
I. THE CIRCUMSTANCES OF THE CASE

text: In his decision of 1 June 1999, the Adıyaman Public Prosecutor indicated that, pursuant to section 24 of the Assemblies and Marches Act (Law no. 2911), the police were under an obligation to warn the group out loud to disperse.
section_path: THE FACTS
I. THE CIRCUMSTANCES OF THE CASE

text: In his decision of 1 June 1999, the Adıyaman Public Prosecutor observed from the video recording of the incident that the police had failed to warn the group out loud to disperse as required by section 24 of the Assemblies and Marches Act (Law no. 2911).
section_path: THE FACTS
I. THE CIRCUMSTANCES OF THE CASE

text: In his decision of 1 June 1999, the Adıyaman Public Prosecutor held that the accused demonstrators had not violated the Assemblies and Marches Act (Law no. 2911).
